questions.prompt: Which MTA came first, out of Berkeley Unix?
Which product bundles mail with calendars, contacts, and groupware?
Postfix stores mailboxes and serves IMAP all by itself.
Sendmail's real configuration file is sendmail.cf. Which file do administrators edit to generate it? (file name)
What's the term for a single relay that all outgoing mail is sent through? (two words)

options: Maps domains to the next host their mail should go to

questions.prompt: Why put a Sendmail relay in front of an internal Exchange server?
options: So the internal server never takes connections from the Internet on port 25, and mail is filtered first

questions.prompt: Marshall's MX record points at a cloud service that plays the same role as an Internet-facing relay.
Which of these is a real chore of running your own mail server?
options: Keeping its IP address off spam blocklists
